scope: V2 apartment/road pilot only; output-ready placement data, not native or art acceptance.
authoring: Explicit fixed islands + deterministic LCG1664525/1013904223, organic holes; no runtime RNG or uniform scatter. Old 30 reused shrub/debris rows retained.
ground_height_source: Canonical phase2.heightAt; excavation/visual footprint+1m excluded; up sampled at0.08m; roots embedded8mm. Native support remains primary acceptance.

grass.name: Six solid low-poly grass blades

patches.role: broken medium dry grass outside leaf-root clearings
medium pale-green and dry tufts around retained birches with bare gaps
short low weeds outside foundation apron and corners
medium neglected yard islands away from basement and service corner
short sparse verge tufts on both road sides and beside pedestrian approach; 45 existing short tufts relocated to three broken near-side shoulder islands
occasional taller sheltered weeds near yard corners, never the road centre

grass.height_policy: patch.height_m is maximum blade height; six blades should span 0.58..1 times it. Preserve unit transforms; author short/medium/tall mesh families, never instance scale.
grass.tint_policy: Tint is final muted sRGB albedo target; writer converts sRGB to linear for MultiMesh colors and uses white base albedo, avoiding double darkening or pale raw-linear color.

counts_are: Implementation observations, not an approved production/performance budget.
